postData.contentHtml:
Extras

Some additional resources of interest.

  • Artifact Evaluation: Tips for Authors, by Rohan Padhye
  • Evaluator Guide, by the AE chairs of EuroSys ‘22
  • HOWTO for AEC Submitters, by Dan Barowy, Charlie Curtsinger, Emma Tosch, John Vilk, and Emery Berger
  • How Are Award-winning Systems Research Artifacts Prepared (Part 1), by Tianyin Xu
  • Security Research Artifacts, a website collecting AE results for security conferences
  • Systems Research Artifacts, a website collecting AE results for systems conferences
  • The ACM Conference on Reproducibility and Replicability
  • The ACM SIGPLAN Empirical Evaluation Guidelines
